method: Same selection system as live play: uniform random shuffle of every admitted question, without account or previous-game history; first 100.

questions.prompt: Name an airline, active now or in the past.
questions.scope: Actual passenger and cargo airlines, past or present, count. Arbitrary IATA/ICAO codes, private owner labels and ground transport companies do not.

questions.prompt: Name a water sport or recreational activity on or in water.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a real island or archipelago.
questions.scope: Real named islands and archipelagos worldwide count, including islands that share a country name. Continental mainlands are not treated as islands. Fictional islands do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a candy or chocolate brand.
questions.scope: Brands and named candy products count; ordinary flavor names alone do not.

questions.prompt: Name a song by Kendrick Lamar.
questions.scope: Released recordings credited to Kendrick Lamar count, including collaborations, features and released covers. Writing or production credit alone does not count. Different versions share one answer.

questions.prompt: Name a free-to-play PC or console game.
questions.scope: Games with an officially free base version count; a temporary free weekend does not.

questions.prompt: Name a character or named boss from a Kirby game.
questions.scope: Officially released named examples from the stated game or franchise count. Mods, fan creations, unreleased leaks, unrelated crossovers and production staff do not. Alternate public names share an answer.

questions.prompt: Name a volcano or named volcanic complex. Dormant and extinct ones count.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name an item found in a first-aid kit.
questions.scope: Named supplies included in established home, travel, workplace or specialist first-aid kits count. This is a trivia inventory, not treatment advice.

questions.prompt: Name a brand that makes athletic shoes.
questions.scope: Real sports-footwear brands count, including specialist running and court-shoe brands.

questions.prompt: Name a tool or machine used for cleaning.
questions.scope: Recognized cleaning tools and machines count, including hand tools, wiping materials and powered cleaning equipment. A brand name or chemical cleaning ingredient alone is not a tool.

questions.prompt: Name a food crop with an edible part that normally grows underground.
questions.scope: Roots, tubers, rhizomes, bulbs, corms and underground fruits count. Named crop kinds and established edible varieties count. A normal above-ground fruit does not count merely because the plant has roots.

questions.prompt: Name a seasoning, including herbs, spices and named spice blends.
Name a tool used for writing or drawing.
questions.scope: Pens, pencils, crayons and other physical implements used to make written or drawn marks count. Paper, erasers alone, ink alone and software applications do not.

questions.prompt: Name a bird of prey.
questions.scope: Established types and named examples count. Alternate standard names are the same answer.

questions.prompt: Name a song by Harry Styles.
questions.scope: Released song titles with the named artist as a lead or vocal guest count, including released mixtape songs and actual group performances. Production-only credits, unofficial leaks and instrumental-only versions do not count. Clean/explicit, live and remix variants share an identity.

questions.prompt: Name a machine or device that uses an electric motor.
questions.scope: The motor can be internal and does not need to move the entire device.

questions.prompt: Name a national capital city.
questions.scope: Current and former national capital cities count, including a country’s officially designated administrative, legislative or judicial capital. Capitals of subnational states alone do not qualify.

questions.prompt: Name a character from the Harry Potter books or films.
questions.scope: Identifiable characters in the Harry Potter novels, films and their epilogues count, including creatures, ghosts and portraits. Real actors are not their fictional characters. Same-name characters share one answer identity.

questions.prompt: Name a song by Queen.
questions.scope: Released recordings credited to Queen count, including collaborations, features and released covers. Writing or production credit alone does not count. Different versions share one answer.

questions.prompt: Name a car, motorcycle, truck or bus manufacturer or brand.
questions.scope: Real current or historical manufacturers and established marques of cars, motorcycles (including racing motorcycles), trucks and buses count, including documented vehicle assembly and coachbuilding firms. A vehicle model alone, a transport operator, an aircraft/rail-only maker, a pure component supplier, a toy or a fictional brand does not count. Actual brand/company names and true renames share an answer.

questions.prompt: Name an emote from Fortnite.
questions.scope: Any recorded season or collaboration counts. These are cosmetic names, not Battle Royale weapon names.

questions.prompt: Name someone who has played in the NHL.
questions.scope: Players with at least one NHL regular-season appearance count. International, college, junior, WHA or minor-league play alone does not.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of shark or ray.
questions.scope: Established groups and species count; familiar common names would be accepted.

questions.prompt: Name a character from DC comics or a DC adaptation.
questions.scope: Named characters appearing in the original franchise, its direct adaptations or sequels count. Actors, production staff, fan characters and characters appearing only in unrelated crossover games do not. Public aliases of one character share a scoring identity.

questions.prompt: Name a crime TV or streaming show.
Name a fast-food or fast-casual restaurant chain.
questions.scope: Real multi-location restaurant chains count worldwide; local independents do not.

questions.prompt: Name a sport or event that has appeared at the modern Olympics.
questions.scope: Summer and Winter Games count, including discontinued events.

questions.prompt: Name a named character from Naruto.
questions.scope: Named characters belonging to the main official franchise count, including named supporting and one-episode characters. Actors, production credits, fan creations and crossover-only guests do not qualify. Actual public nicknames and personas share one answer identity.

questions.prompt: Name a named character from Phineas and Ferb.
questions.scope: Named characters belonging to the main official franchise count, including named supporting and one-episode characters. Actors, production credits, fan creations and crossover-only guests do not qualify. Actual public nicknames and personas share one answer identity.

questions.prompt: Name an anime TV or streaming show.
Name an athlete who has won an Olympic gold medal.
questions.scope: Any modern Summer or Winter Games count; team-event gold medals count too.

questions.prompt: Name a playable hero in Overwatch.
questions.scope: The full official Overwatch roster in the October 25, 2026 snapshot counts, including heroes introduced while it was called Overwatch 2. Skins and unplayable story characters do not.

questions.prompt: Name a brand of chips, crackers, popcorn or another packaged savory snack.
questions.scope: Established named foods, products or varieties matching the whole subject count. Actual public synonyms share one identity. Invented ingredient combinations and generic descriptions do not create new answers.

questions.prompt: Name a drivable vehicle or vehicle body that has appeared in Fortnite Battle Royale.
questions.scope: Drivable vehicles and vehicle bodies usable in Fortnite Battle Royale count, including historical vehicles. Animals and gliders are not vehicles for this question.

questions.prompt: Name a song by Future.
questions.scope: Released song titles with Future as a lead or vocal guest count, including released mixtape songs and actual group performances. Production-only credits, unofficial leaks and instrumental-only versions do not count. Clean/explicit, live and remix variants share an answer identity.

questions.prompt: Name an item or trainer device from a Pokémon video game.
questions.scope: Named usable items and trainer devices from released Pokémon video games count, including medicine, Poké Balls, Berries, held/key items, TMs/TRs, evolution items, Pokédexes and trainer communication/navigation devices. Historical versions of the same item name share one answer. Pokémon, moves and Abilities are separate concepts.

questions.prompt: Name an item that restores health in a video game.
questions.scope: Named consumables, pickups and healing items count; name the actual item.

questions.prompt: Name a drink you can order at a coffee shop.
questions.scope: Established drink names count, including non-coffee drinks; every flavor combination would not be a separate answer.

questions.prompt: Name a biome in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Base-game and recorded expansion names count. Versions of the same named object count once.

questions.prompt: Name a bone or named group of bones in the human skeleton.
questions.scope: Standard named bones, fused bones and familiar bone groups count. Left and right instances are the same answer. Cartilage, joints, muscles and organs are not bones.

questions.prompt: Name a fictional detective.
questions.scope: Named fictional professional detectives and amateur sleuths count across books, comics, film, TV and games. A character must actually investigate cases; merely appearing in a mystery does not qualify.

questions.prompt: Name something people use to measure things.
questions.scope: Named measuring instruments count; the quantity being measured can be distance, time, temperature or something else.

questions.prompt: Name a non-block inventory item in vanilla Minecraft.
questions.scope: Items with a non-block identity in current vanilla Java Edition count, including tools, weapons, food, materials, spawn eggs and worn equipment. Placeable blocks are a separate question; a block item is not accepted here.

questions.prompt: Name a character from the Pokemon animated series.
questions.scope: Named characters appearing in the original franchise, its direct adaptations or sequels count. Actors, production staff, fan characters and characters appearing only in unrelated crossover games do not. Public aliases of one character share a scoring identity.

questions.prompt: Name a movie involving time travel or a time loop.
questions.scope: Films in which characters travel through time or experience a repeating time loop count, including animated movies and shorts. Ordinary flashbacks, dreams about the past and a futuristic setting alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a superhero movie.

questions.prompt: Name a dumpling or established regional dumpling variety.

questions.prompt: Name a character from How to Train Your Dragon.
questions.scope: Named characters appearing in the original franchise, its direct adaptations or sequels count. Actors, production staff, fan characters and characters appearing only in unrelated crossover games do not. Public aliases of one character share a scoring identity.

questions.prompt: Name an NBA head coach, past or present.
questions.scope: Head coaches and interim head coaches of NBA teams count. Assistant-only, college-only and player-only roles do not qualify.

questions.prompt: Name a type of school or educational institution.
questions.scope: Named examples of the whole subject count, including documented historical examples. Real public synonyms share one answer; arbitrary initials and invented combinations do not.

questions.prompt: Name a fantasy movie.
Name a weather event or weather condition.
questions.scope: Common and established technical names count; fictional weather does not.

questions.prompt: Name a named character from The Simpsons.
questions.scope: Named characters belonging to the main official franchise count, including named supporting and one-episode characters. Actors, production credits, fan creations and crossover-only guests do not qualify. Actual public nicknames and personas share one answer identity.

questions.prompt: Name a salad dressing.
questions.scope: Named dressings, traditional dressing preparations and brands sold as salad dressing count. A generic ingredient can qualify only when it is also conventionally used as a dressing on its own; arbitrary invented ingredient combinations do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a computer manufacturer or computer brand.
questions.scope: Named examples of the whole subject count, including documented historical examples. Real public synonyms share one answer; arbitrary initials and invented combinations do not.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of wild cat.
questions.scope: Living and recently extinct species in the Mammal Diversity Database, plus established named animal groups, count. English names, documented scientific names and genuine public synonyms count. Prehistoric fossil-only species are outside this current-species inventory. Domestic cat breeds and captive cross-species hybrids do not count. Named tiger and lion populations share their parent species identity.

questions.prompt: Name a song by Lil Uzi Vert.
questions.scope: Released song titles with Lil Uzi Vert as a lead or vocal guest count, including released mixtape songs and actual group performances. questions.prompt: Name an animal that can deliver venom.

questions.prompt: Name a fictional pirate.
